# Rule: Calling convention macro redefined after use

_Canonical rule slug:_ `calling-convention-macro-redefined-after-use`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A convention macro is redefined after the declaration that uses it; only the later definition differs, so the declared convention and the binary interface are unchanged.
